brief:
Settlers threw rocks at Palestinian civilian vehicles in an incident south of Tulkarm, according to Shehab Wire. The attack targeted multiple cars traveling through the area on Tuesday, continuing a pattern of confrontations between settlers and Palestinians in the northern West Bank region.

The stoning occurred amid escalating tensions in areas surrounding settlements near Tulkarm. Palestinian residents have reported a series of attacks on their vehicles in recent weeks, with settlers targeting transport routes used by civilians moving between communities. Israeli security forces have not yet issued statements regarding the incident or any response measures.
